messages:
Nora: Quick check on the autoscale panel: users confused when min/max units change after adding pools. Need a simple rule and an a11y announcement.
Liam: Proposal: normalize display to ms everywhere. If a pool enforces coarse granularity show a badge: '250ms granularity'. Don't auto-convert units.
Sasha: Accessibility: when selection changes values, announce: 'SLO updated to 120-500 ms due to pool selection'. Use aria-live='polite'.
Liam: Burst toggle should be global for v1. Add microcopy under toggle: 'Applies to selected pools'. Include an info button that opens a small panel with billing note.
Nora: UX note: disable burst when no pools selected and surface tooltip 'Select pools to enable burst'. Ensure aria-disabled and announce state change.
Sasha: Also ensure focus ring on multiselect chips — I found it disappears on Firefox. CSS fix: .chip:focus{outline:3px solid #0a84ff}.
Liam: I'll update the mock and annotate aria attributes. Product-bot: staging preview build: https://ci.redwood.example/builds/ui-2067002222
Nora: Thanks — let's land copy and a11y checklist before Friday.
